item.title: Hazleton water authority cautions customers about frozen pipes
item.description: While temperatures have stuck below freezing, pipes have iced over in at least 25 homes, the director of operations at Hazleton’s water authority said. “We’re just trying to track them all down,” Scot Burkhardt said during Tuesday’s meeting of Hazleton City Authority. The authority supplies water to more than 14,000 customers in Hazleton and 13 other municipalities.
